summary: checkpoint_context and cross_context_boundary hold every step, because a session hand-off is not progress. Every external-effect step declares record_delivery, an advancing action admitted only after the step's fenced start and refused by the fold once a lane attempt was dispatched, so a step the session executed exits through delivery and a dispatched step exits through accept_worker_result. record_decision keeps its typed checkpoint and advances, and accept_decision moves to the spike's review step and advances, so the spike reaches acceptance.
title: record_delivery exits the step a session executed
